EXT.evidence: Gives brief, minimal replies and reacts rather than leads ('Okay ..', 'Wow.', 'What?'), showing little talkativeness or social energy.

AGR.evidence: Politely returns an item and expresses thanks ('I guess this belongs to you. And thank you for giving it to me.'), showing cooperation and courtesy.

CON.evidence: Responsibly returns something that belongs to the other person, indicating follow-through and orderliness.

NEU.evidence: Anxious, self-conscious reactions and discomfort ('Oh! Well, um... I've got plugs! ... I've got lenses! But I hate sticking my finger in my eye!').

OPN.evidence: No clear signs of curiosity, imagination, or openness to new ideas in the exchange.
